narrative.overview: HalluciSense visualizes multi-pillar AI hallucination analysis through the lens of a deep-space astronomical observatory. The canvas is a pitch-dark, vacuum-like obsidian void upon which translucent frosted-glass instrumentation panels float with quiet authority.
keyCharacteristics: Deep Space Atmosphere: Infinite dark backdrop with layered translucent glass surfaces.
Tactile Scientific Instrumentation: Rounded-xl panels, crisp 1px borders with subtle hover highlights.
Spectral Signal Precision: Vibrant primary accents and strict 4-tier risk tokens for instant cognitive scanning.
Mathematical Typography: Space Grotesk titles paired with high-contrast Monospace metrics.

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Vibrant primary accents are reserved for active actions, key confidence metrics, and focus states, occupying <= 10% of any given viewport.

rules.name: The Semantic Invariance Rule
rules.body: Status hues are strictly reserved for verification risk classifications and must never be repurposed for generic decorative styling.

rules.name: The Tabular Metric Rule
rules.body: All floating-point scores, execution latencies, and probability values must be rendered in font-mono with tabular numbers.

rules.name: The Luminescent Border Rule
rules.body: Depth is primarily established by micro-contrast border luminance rather than heavy drop shadows.

dos: Do wrap tabular floating-point readouts and latencies in font-mono.
Do maintain the 4-tier risk color taxonomy consistently across graphs, badges, cards, and token heatmaps.
Do use GlassCard with backdrop-blur-xl and 1px translucent borders for all content containers.
Do provide smooth transitions on hover and active states.
donts: Don't use opaque solid white or light-gray backgrounds for cards on dark views.
Don't create aggressive multi-colored drop shadows that detract from data readability.
Don't use status colors (emerald, amber, red) for non-status decorative accents.
Don't remove monospace alignment from quantitative evaluation scores.
